summary: Fusion Fuel Green PLC (Irish filer) discloses via Form 6-K (press release) an update to its acquisition of up to 100% of Royal Uranium Inc. under a February 18, 2026 Share Exchange Agreement. The release notes potential revenue from Royal Uranium's NSR royalty at the Huemul Project (Argentina), being explored by Jaguar Uranium Corp. Financial terms (price per share, premium, implied value) are not stated. The transaction remains subject to closing conditions including Irish regulatory approval, shareholder vote, and other consents. No advisor or board recommendation is named. Risk-arb: watch regulatory and shareholder approvals; the deal's completion hinges on conditions and commodity exploration success.
